analysis.campaignTitle: Vi spoler tiden frem... (W31 Sæsonen skifter)
analysis.primaryGoal: Inspire customers to refresh or update their packaging with autumn-themed styles
analysis.audience: Existing customers, primarily B2B/jewellery or boutique retailers seeking packaging options

visualStyle.imageStyle: Light, soft, lifestyle imagery with natural props (fall leaves, fabric) and clean product groupings

copyStyle.urgency: Gentle, implied by seasonal change but not overtly urgent

reusablePatterns: Theme-driven introduction referencing time or seasonality
Showcasing product variants in a styled hero image
Framing products as 'looks' or inspiration rather than just items
Grid of secondary CTAs for easy navigation by product type
Palette and photography aligned with seasonal color mood
risks: Copy may feel non-specific if not seasonally relevant
Not all customers may relate to the inspiration-driven approach

confidence.notes: All main Danish text is clearly visible. No performance data or explicit subject/preheader provided.
